title: Reduce network WebView flat exports
summary: Removed the remaining Network WebView flat compatibility exports by moving app event wiring, command-history rendering, and smoke readiness checks to the mediaPipelineNetworkView namespace.
reason: The active cleanup backlog calls for reducing transitional flat window.* exports opportunistically by touched domain while preserving intentional test hooks and WebView evidence.
behavior_before: networkView.js still exported renderNetworkOpenHistory and initNetworkViewEvents directly onto window, and app/tests consumed those network helpers through flat globals.
behavior_after: networkView.js exposes Network helpers only through window.mediaPipelineNetworkView; app.js, commandHistory.js, and WebView smokes use namespace-first network access.
tests_added: Updated tests.webview.test_webview_browser_network_smoke namespace readiness coverage for Network helpers
Updated tests.webview.test_webview_command_evidence_smoke namespace rendering coverage for Network open history
rollback_plan: Restore the two network flat window assignments, switch app/command-history/tests back to flat global access, revert the WebView global export inventory and regenerated summaries, and remove this change packet.
notes:
Removed remaining network flat compatibility exports after namespace migration.
Switched network event initialization to mediaPipelineNetworkView namespace access.
Switched network command-history rendering to mediaPipelineNetworkView namespace access.
Updated network browser smoke readiness checks to require namespace network functions instead of flat globals.
Updated command-evidence smoke to render network open history through the namespace object.
Updated static Local API WebView asset assertions for namespace-first network wiring.
Updated WebView global export inventory counts and manifest after removing network flat exports.
